protocol.input: every LC4 + LPLC2 cell of the stimulated side gets the ramp (M7a2)
protocol.tick_time_origin: end of the 5 s warm-up (ramp onset at tick time 200)
protocol.H: first action decided at a tick end e with 200 < e <= 800 is the correct one
protocol.F600: windows starting at a tick end e0 (e0 + 600 <= 30000) with any action at a tick end e, e0 < e <= e0 + 600
protocol.warmup_spikes: visible to the decoder when its window reaches back past tick time 0
protocol.selection: max J = H - F600; ties -> smaller W, then smaller n
